_instructions: Paste the contents of the 'mcpServers' object into:
Settings → Copilot → Cloud agent → MCP configuration (in the JSON editor)
Secrets required in the 'copilot' GitHub environment
(Settings → Environments → copilot → Environment secrets):
MCP server Lambda Function URLs (retrieve from Terraform outputs after LS-2852/2853/2854 deploy):
MCP_JIRA_URL    — https://<id>.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws
MCP_GITHUB_URL  — https://<id>.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws
MCP_CI_URL      — https://<id>.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws
AWS credentials are NOT needed as secrets — the GitHub Actions OIDC role
(arn:aws:iam::176661590736:role/legacy-sports-dev-github-actions) already has the
mcp_invoke IAM policy attached. copilot-setup-steps.yml assumes this role via OIDC
and starts the local signing proxy, which signs requests with SigV4 before forwarding
them to the Lambda Function URLs.
The following are NOT needed as secrets here — set automatically by copilot-setup-steps.yml:
GH_TOKEN              — generated from the Agent Author GitHub App
GITHUB_TOKEN          — standard GitHub-provided token
DATABASE_URL          — postgresql://legacy_sports:...
USE_LOCAL_CREDENTIALS — true
Jira credentials (JIRA_CLIENT_ID, JIRA_CLIENT_SECRET, JIRA_CLOUD_ID, etc.) are NO LONGER
needed as environment secrets — they are stored in AWS Secrets Manager on the hosted
legacy-sports-jira Lambda and injected at invocation time.
Servers NOT included by default (require additional setup to enable in Copilot cloud):
legacy-sports-aws    — requires interactive AWS SSO login (unavailable in cloud)
legacy-sports-browser — not included by default; to enable: add 'npx playwright install chromium'
to copilot-setup-steps.yml, then add the server entry to this config
This file is the canonical source committed to the repo. Do NOT duplicate the mcpServers
JSON into other committed files or embed secrets here — secrets are configured separately
via GitHub Settings → Environments → copilot → Environment secrets.
